pages.text: $(l)Lag$()$(li)To prevent severe lag with UMF, always keep an Import Interface with a Trash Card active in the network.
$(l)Fluid Hatches$()$(li)You can take the fluid out of a hatch before breaking it.$(li)For large fluid storage, use black hole units or fluid drawers (~15M mB each at max tier).
$(li)Do not place flux points directly on Woot factories; use a cryo-stabilized fluxduct between them to prevent disconnections.
